info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Counterparty Risk Assessment API
info.description: The Counterparty Risk Assessment API enables financial institutions to evaluate and manage the risk associated with their counterparties. This API allows users to submit data related to counterparty transactions and receive an analysis of risk levels, facilitating better decision-making in financial operations. Typical consumers of this API include risk managers, compliance officers, and financial analysts looking to mitigate exposure and ensure regulatory compliance. By effectively managing counterparty risk, organizations can enhance their financial stability and operational efficiency.

post.description: This operation allows you to create a new counterparty risk assessment within the account management system, helping to evaluate the potential risks associated with counterparties.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit necessary data for counterparty risk assessment. It contains the relevant information required for the operation and must adhere to the specified schema.
